The '''resource probe droid''' was manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], and was based on their standard [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] design. The resource probe droid was designed to find and analyze potential [[Mining/Legends|mining]] sites. The droid was deployed via [[Hyperdrive pod/Legends|hyperdrive pod]] to a target [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
